**Test build 4**: the first **Nexo Server for Windows** download. Host a server for your friends with one
zip: no Node, Docker or WSL, and you can play on the same PC. Only friends on test builds get the app
update; everyone else stays on v0.4.0-beta.2.

## What to test: hosting with Nexo Server

1. Download **`Nexo-Server-0.4.0-test.4-win-x64.zip`** from the **Assets** below and extract it.
2. Double-click **`nexo-server.exe`** (SmartScreen: **More info → Run anyway**).
3. Pick a server name and a password (Enter keeps the suggestions).
4. Windows Firewall asks about `nexo-server.exe` and `livekit-server.exe`: click **Allow** on both.
5. Send a friend the **Invite your friends** box. Join yourself with `http://localhost:3001`.

Please tell us:

- Could your friend connect, talk and stream? Which address did they use (Tailscale, internet, same
  network)?
- What the window said about your network (Tailscale, automatic port forwarding, or the CGNAT message).
- Whether the status line (online, in voice, streaming, PC upload) looked right.
- Anything confusing in the setup questions or the invite.

More: `nexo-server --help`, and the [server guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/feat/server-cli/docs/SERVER.md#nexo-server-for-windows-recommended).
Your data lives in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Nexo Server`.

> This test server is separate from your group's current server: friends join it by entering its
> address in Nexo (a new server means new names and empty channels).

## The app

Same as v0.4.0-beta.2. Already on a test build? Nothing to do: Nexo updates itself. To go back to the
regular releases: **Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart Nexo.
